_doc: Tessera audio events (docs/skill-v2/10-audio-system-design.md), read by AudioBank. Event ids are <category>.<subject>.<action>; files are sfx_<category>_<subject>_<action>_<nn>.wav (tier files _s/_m/_l). A card phase resolves cards[id] -> archetypes[delivery][impact] -> archetypes[delivery]['*'] -> archetypes['*'][impact] -> archetypes['*']['*']; an empty string means silent.

music._doc: Music (docs/design/audio/music-plan.md), played by MusicPlayer on the Music bus. One track per flow state; loop_start = where the loop jumps back to (the file ends at the loop end). Raw takes and song ids: audio_src/pixellab/music/SOURCES.md. regions: {region_id: {explore|battle|boss: track}}; a state a region does not list uses the shared track (ch1 = Rừng Sương = the shared set).
